values.note: Five singles and one double (site 1, 56-ft back-in spur). Site 4 takes 41 ft, 5 (the pull-through) 32 ft, 6 26 ft, 2 25 ft and 3 22 ft. Two vehicles per single site, four at the double; every vehicle must fit on the spur.

sites.source: recreation.gov 10299335 campsite catalog (Max Vehicle Length / Driveway Length / Driveway Entry per site) + notice (vehicle limits), read 2026-11-20

values.note: Hand-pump well water, usually mid-May to late November but subject to pump work and testing - bring water or call ahead. Trash bins. The camp host stays at LaPrele Guard Station.

facilities.source: FS page ('Vault Toilet (1)'; 'Potable water is available'; host at LaPrele Guard Station) + recreation.gov facility description (hand pump, trash collection, water caveat), read 2026-11-20

values.note: Site 2 is first-come only, and any site not reserved is first-come. Check-in 2 pm, check-out 1 pm.

note: Medicine Bow NF campground under mature pines at the west end of the Laramie Range (Douglas RD), with Campbell Creek running through it. Reached from Douglas on WY-91 and Converse County Road 24 through LaPrele Canyon, crossing LaPrele Creek several times; expect delays for road work and cattle drives. No horses. --Claude

ACCESS: the stored note's 'rough/rutted, difficult when wet' is not on any agency page (FS/rec.gov say only road-work and cattle-drive delays; no 4WD or high-clearance wording) - removed. Not a drop candidate.
SITES: site 3 (22 ft) is short for a 23-ft rig; sites 1, 2, 4, 5, 6 take it. rec.gov's equipment lists for sites 2-6 name trailers/fifth wheels, not motorhomes; length limits applied as for trailers.

HORSES: FS 'No horses' / 'Horse/Pack animals are not allowed', but rec.gov site 3 lists 'Horse' among allowed equipment and the facility lists Horseback Riding Trails - minor rec.gov data slip; general campground, horses excluded, no flag beyond this.
OHV: rec.gov amenities list Off-Road Vehicle and Motorcycle Trails nearby; the FS page notes the state OHV sticker for FS trails. A general campground with OHV nearby - flag only.
